Funding Opportunities
Teaching Assistantships that include a stipend, tuition, and fee waiver, and student health insurance may be available to Ph.D. EEB students on a competitive basis. Additional support for Ph.D. research projects may be available from faculty members in the form of Research Assistantships.
Financial Aid and Scholarship Office
Questions about your federal financial aid options? Visit the Financial Aid Office to understand your financial aid options, how to check for eligibility, and apply for aid.
Also, visit our Scholarship Office and complete the checklist to maximize your funding opportunities.
